issues.t: Severe frame rust
issues.sym: Flaking, scaling or soft spots on the frame, often near the rear spring mounts and crossmembers. In bad cases the frame cracks or rusts through and suspension mounts can let go.
issues.why: Frames on first-generation trucks were not protected well enough against corrosion, especially where road salt is used. Toyota ran an extended frame corrosion program with frame replacement or buyback for badly rusted trucks.
issues.next: Have the whole frame checked from underneath, including tapping suspect areas. If it is soft or perforated, stop driving the truck until it is repaired, and ask a Toyota dealer whether any program still applies to your VIN.

issues.t: Front lower ball joint can separate
issues.sym: Clunking or knocking from the front end over bumps, loose or wandering steering. If the joint comes apart, the wheel can fold under the truck.
issues.why: The lower ball joint surface could be scratched during assembly, letting the joint wear and loosen until it pulls out. Toyota recalled these trucks to replace the lower ball joints.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. Any front clunk on these trucks should be inspected right away, and do not drive it far if the ball joints are loose.

issues.t: Spare tire carrier can rust and drop the spare
issues.sym: Rattling from under the rear of the truck, a spare tire hanging low, or the spare missing altogether.
issues.why: A plate in the spare tire hoist did not get enough protective coating at the factory. Road salt corrodes it until it breaks and the spare can fall onto the road. Toyota recalled trucks in cold-climate states to replace the carrier.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and look at how the spare is hanging. Have the carrier replaced if it is rusty or loose.

issues.t: Frame rust-through
issues.sym: Heavy scaling, holes or cracks in the frame, especially near the rear leaf spring hangers and crossmembers. Rusted brake lines may be found nearby.
issues.why: These frames also lacked enough corrosion protection. Toyota extended frame coverage under warranty enhancement ZH6 and later settled a class action that paid for frame inspections and replacements.
issues.next: Have the frame inspected thoroughly. If the frame is perforated or the spring mounts are weak, park the truck until it is repaired. Ask a Toyota dealer whether your VIN still has any coverage.

issues.t: Excess frame corrosion in salt states
issues.sym: More rust on the frame than you would expect for the truck's age, flaking scale, or open rust holes.
issues.why: Trucks driven in cold, salted states could corrode faster than normal. Toyota ran a limited service campaign to inspect frames, apply a rust-resistant coating and plugs, and replace the frame if the rust was already severe.
issues.next: Ask a Toyota dealer whether your truck is covered by the frame corrosion campaign and have the frame inspected. Keep the underside rinsed in winter.
src: Toyota limited service campaign H0F / K0D

issues.t: Rear leaf spring can break
issues.sym: A bang or clunk from the rear, the truck sitting lower on one side, or a rear end that sags under load.
issues.why: The rear leaf spring can crack and break. A broken piece can shift and puncture the fuel tank. Toyota recalled Pre-Runner and 4x4 trucks to inspect and replace the springs.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 14V604. If the truck sits uneven or you smell fuel, do not haul or tow and get it inspected right away.

issues.t: Rear leaf springs squeak
issues.sym: Squeaking or creaking from the rear over bumps, driveway entrances or when loading the bed.
issues.why: The leaf spring leaves rub against each other. Toyota released updated silencer pads between the leaves.
issues.next: Have a shop install the updated spring silencer pads. Also check the springs for cracks while they are in there.

issues.t: Clunk or bump when starting or stopping
issues.sym: A single clunk, or a feeling like being bumped from behind, as you pull away or come to a stop.
issues.why: The sliding joint on the driveshaft gets dry and sticks, then releases with a jolt. Toyota issued bulletins for cleaning and greasing it on 2WD and 4WD trucks.
issues.next: Ask a shop to clean and grease the driveshaft slip joint. It is annoying rather than dangerous.

issues.t: Driveshaft U-joint vibration
issues.sym: Vibration through the floor or seat that rises with speed, or squeaking and clunking from under the truck.
issues.why: The universal joints on the driveshaft can wear. Toyota set up a customer support program because a worn joint can damage the driveshaft if ignored.
issues.next: Have the U-joints checked for play. Ask a Toyota dealer whether the support program still applies to your VIN.

issues.t: Steering shaft rattle
issues.sym: A rattle or clunk felt in the steering wheel on rough roads, sometimes with steering that feels a bit notchy.
issues.why: The joint in the steering intermediate shaft wears and develops play. Toyota issued a bulletin for the rattle.
issues.next: Have the intermediate steering shaft checked and replaced if it has play.

issues.t: Headlight lens melting or bubbling
issues.sym: Warped, bubbled or cracked plastic inside the headlight, a burnt plastic smell, or a dim beam.
issues.why: Heat from the daytime running light bulb can distort the inner lens of the headlight. Toyota issued bulletins and an extended warranty for the headlights.
issues.next: Inspect both headlights and replace damaged units. Ask a dealer whether the extended headlight warranty covers your truck.

issues.t: Secondary air injection pump failure
issues.sym: Check engine light with codes P2440 or P2442, sometimes the truck going into reduced power for a short time after a cold start.
issues.why: Moisture gets into the air injection pump and its valve, which then stick or fail. Toyota issued a bulletin and extended coverage on the system.
issues.next: Have the codes read and ask a Toyota dealer whether your truck has extended coverage for the air injection system.

issues.t: Rear differential can leak and lock up
issues.sym: Oil on the rear differential or dripping under the rear axle, whining or grinding from the rear, and in the worst case the rear wheels locking.
issues.why: Nuts holding the differential carrier could loosen and let oil escape. Without oil the differential can be damaged or seize. Toyota recalled these trucks.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. If you see oil on the rear axle or hear grinding, stop driving and have it towed in.

issues.t: Differential whine or grinding
issues.sym: A whine from the rear at highway speed, or a grinding or groaning from the front while driving in 2WD on a 4WD truck.
issues.why: Toyota issued separate bulletins for rear differential whine on certain 4WD Double Cabs and for front differential noise in 2WD mode.
issues.next: Have a dealer check the noise against the bulletins. Make sure the recall above has also been done.

issues.t: Brake master cylinder can leak inside
issues.sym: A soft brake pedal that sinks toward the floor, longer stopping distances, and possibly a brake warning light.
issues.why: A seal in the master cylinder from one supplier was machined wrong, so fluid can bypass inside and weaken the front brakes. Toyota recalled affected trucks.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. If the pedal sinks, do not drive the truck until it is repaired.

issues.t: Automatic hunts for gears or engages late
issues.sym: The 6-speed automatic keeps shifting up and down on hills or at steady speed, hesitates when you press the gas, or is slow to engage when shifted into Drive or Reverse.
issues.why: The transmission is programmed to stay in high gears for fuel economy. Toyota issued bulletins for delayed engagement and other shift complaints.
issues.next: Ask a Toyota dealer whether a software update or bulletin applies to your truck.

issues.t: Vibration when slowing down
issues.sym: A shudder or vibration felt in the truck as it slows from about 30 mph down to 10 mph.
issues.why: Toyota issued bulletins for this vibration on automatic trucks during deceleration.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm the condition and apply the bulletin repair.

issues.t: Vacuum pump knock or idle surge
issues.sym: A knocking noise from the engine bay, or engine speed surging at idle when you turn the steering wheel.
issues.why: Toyota issued separate bulletins for a knocking brake vacuum pump and for idle surge with steering input on this engine.
issues.next: Have a dealer check for the matching bulletin. The pump feeds brake assist, so get a loud knock looked at.

issues.t: Manual gearbox hard to shift from 5th or 6th
issues.sym: The 6-speed manual is hard to pull out of 5th or 6th gear after a long drive.
issues.why: Toyota issued a bulletin for this shifting problem on the manual transmission.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to check the truck against the bulletin.

issues.t: Suspension squeaks and howls
issues.sym: Squeaking from the rear springs over bumps or when loading the bed, or a howl or whistle from the front at about 25 to 45 mph.
issues.why: Toyota issued bulletins for rear leaf spring squeak and for noise from the front lower control arms.
issues.next: Have a dealer apply the matching bulletin repair.

issues.t: Rear axle shaft can come loose
issues.sym: Grinding or clunking from a rear wheel, a wobble, or a rear wheel that moves out from the truck.
issues.why: Debris during assembly could keep the axle retaining nuts from staying tight, so the axle shaft can pull away from the housing. That hurts stability and braking. Toyota recalled these trucks.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. If you hear grinding from a rear wheel, stop driving and have it towed.

issues.t: New 8-speed automatic slips into neutral or won't shift
issues.sym: The truck suddenly loses drive or acts like it is in neutral, feels sluggish, or stays stuck in one gear, with a check engine light.
issues.why: Some early trucks had transmission failures, sometimes at very low mileage. Toyota issued a service bulletin covering the related trouble codes.
issues.next: If the truck loses drive, pull over safely and have it towed. Ask a Toyota dealer to check for bulletin T-SB-0076-24.

issues.t: Rear brake hose can be damaged by mud
issues.sym: Brake fluid wetting the inside of a rear wheel, a low brake fluid warning, or a soft pedal.
issues.why: Mud and dirt packed inside the rear wheels can rub through the rear brake hoses and cause a fluid leak. Toyota recalled 4WD trucks to replace both hoses.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. If the pedal is soft or the brake light is on, do not drive until it is repaired.

issues.t: Front driveshaft CV joint can break
issues.sym: Clicking or clunking from the front when turning, vibration, or a truck that rolls in Park on full-time 4WD models.
issues.why: The joint on the front driveshafts can deform and break. That can affect steering, and on full-time 4WD trucks the truck may roll if the parking brake is not set. Toyota recalled affected trucks.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and always set the parking brake until it is repaired.

issues.t: Shock absorber reservoir can corrode off
issues.sym: A shock reservoir hanging loose or missing, oil on the shock, or a bouncier ride.
issues.why: The metal flange holding the external oil reservoir on the front and rear shocks can corrode and fail, letting the reservoir drop onto the road. Toyota recalled affected trucks.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and look at the shocks for loose reservoirs or leaks.

issues.t: Front suspension support can crack (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the front end, steering that pulls or wanders, or a front wheel that looks out of position.
issues.why: A front suspension support on early trucks can crack under certain driving conditions, which can lead to loss of control. Toyota recalled them to repair the support.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall, since many old trucks were never brought in. If the front end clunks or the steering feels loose, have it inspected before driving further.

issues.t: Fuel inlet hose can be damaged in a side crash (Double Cab recall)
issues.sym: Usually nothing in normal driving. After a side impact there may be a fuel smell or a leak near the filler.
issues.why: On Double Cab trucks the body can press into the fuel inlet hose in a side collision and cause a leak. Toyota recalled them to add a protector over the hose.
issues.next: Check the VIN to confirm the recall was done. Any fuel smell after a collision should be inspected before the truck is driven again.

issues.t: Fuel pump in the tank can fail (recall)
issues.sym: Rough running, hesitation, a check engine light, the engine stalling while driving, or not starting.
issues.why: The low-pressure fuel pump inside the tank can stop working. Toyota recalled the trucks to fit an improved pump, and later widened the recall to more model years.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have the pump replaced. If the engine stumbles or stalls, stop driving and have the truck towed in.

issues.t: Child seat top anchor welds may be weak (recall)
issues.sym: No warning signs. A child seat could shift in a hard stop or a crash.
issues.why: The welds on the upper child seat anchors may not be strong enough. Toyota recalled the trucks to inspect the anchors and reweld them if needed.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall before using a child seat with the top tether, and have the anchors inspected soon.

issues.t: Steering wheel spiral cable can lose its airbag connection (recall)
issues.sym: An airbag warning light, sometimes with steering wheel buttons or the horn not working.
issues.why: The spiral cable inside the steering column links the driver airbag to the rest of the truck. Its connection can come apart, which switches off the driver airbag.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have the cable inspected soon. An airbag light that stays on means the airbag may not work in a crash.

issues.t: Instrument cluster can start up blank (recall)
issues.sym: The digital gauge display stays dark or missing at startup, so the speed, brake warning and tire pressure lights are not shown.
issues.why: A software error can keep the instrument panel from loading when the truck is started. Toyota recalled the trucks for a software update.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get the update. If the display is blank, switch the truck off and restart it before driving.

issues.t: Trailer wiring converter can short out (recall)
issues.sym: Blown fuses, trailer lights that do not work, or a burning smell near the hitch wiring.
issues.why: The trailer wiring converter fitted behind the bumper can short circuit.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. Stop towing until the wiring has been checked.

issues.t: Owner's manual misstates the airbag on-off switch (recall)
issues.sym: Nothing on the truck itself.
issues.why: The printed instructions for using the passenger airbag on-off switch were wrong, so the switch may be used incorrectly.
issues.next: Get the corrected manual insert from a dealer and read it before switching the passenger airbag off.

issues.t: Valve springs can break and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: A tick or misfire, rough running, then the engine cutting out while driving.
issues.why: Some valve springs were made out of spec and can break, which stops the valve working properly.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have it done. A stall in traffic is a real risk.

issues.t: Crankshaft position sensor can fail and stall the V6 (recall)
issues.sym: A no-start, or the engine suddenly cutting out while driving.
issues.why: The crank position sensor on the V6 can fail, so the engine computer loses the signal it needs to run.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. Do not ignore a stall, and get the sensor replaced free.
